text: The Nominating Panel – Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal will conduct interviews and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal.

The Nominating Panel - Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal recommends that: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal for a term of office beginning January 1, 2024 and ending on November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed: Matthew Brown Nigel Waterman
